business_summary: DTF Tax-Free Income 2028 Term Fund Inc. is a closed-ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Virtus Investment Partners, Inc. The fund is managed by Duff & Phelps Investment Management Co. It invests primarily in a diversified portfolio of investment grade tax-exempt utility obligations. The fund invests in various sectors, such as water and sewer, electric utilities, prerefunded utilities, pollution control, and nonutilities. It invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It was formerly known as DTF Tax-Free Income Inc. DTF Tax-Free Income 2028 Term Fund Inc. was formed on November, 1991 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: DTF Tax-Free Income 2028 Term Fund Inc.는 Virtus Investment Partners, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Duff & Phelps Investment Management Co.가 관리합니다. 이 펀드는 주로 투자 등급 면세 유틸리티 의무의 다양한 포트폴리오에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 상하수도, 전기 유틸리티, 선불 유틸리티, 오염 통제, 비 유틸리티 등 다양한 부문에 투자합니다. 미국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이전에는 DTF Tax-Free Income Inc.로 알려졌습니다. DTF Tax-Free Income 2028 Term Fund Inc.는 1991년 11월에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
